calculation_provenance.assumptions: Four 100-card Hobby-exclusive non-autograph base tiers independently imply 75,000 Hobby packs: Tie-Dye /25 at 1:30, Orange /15 at 1:50, Black /10 at 1:75 and Red /5 at 1:150. Conditional on these serial ceilings substantially reaching Hobby packs. Only reviewed Hobby-exclusive unnumbered designs are estimated; shared regular base/inserts and event-distributed cards stay withheld. Estimates are not manufacturer-confirmed production totals.
